source_basis: Opening sentence: as an essential asset of port, data plays an increasingly important role.
interpretation: The subject is raised by its growing importance before any method is named.
applicability: Reusable wherever a paper must lift its subject before its method.
counterevidence: The sentence names no mechanism, so it cannot carry a result.

source_basis: For Session 1, this paper innovatively proposed to establish a standard meta-network as the basis for subsequent work.
interpretation: Novelty is claimed and the model is positioned as the base for everything after it.
applicability: Reusable when a first model genuinely feeds every later one.
counterevidence: The adverb innovatively is asserted, not earned, in this sentence.

source_basis: According to the expectations of ICM Corporation, this paper selected people, technology, process and data information as the modeling objects.
interpretation: The choice of objects is grounded in the client's own brief.
applicability: Reusable when the brief really does fix the objects.
counterevidence: No quotation from ICM is given, so the expectation is paraphrased.

source_basis: Specific modeling elements and correlations were identified through government documents, institution reports, and academic publications.
interpretation: Three sources are named in one breath, which credits the evidence base.
applicability: Reusable for any inventory drawn from named source types.
counterevidence: None of the three sources is cited individually here.

source_basis: Finally, a standard meta-network model with 33 nodes and 199 links was developed.
interpretation: The session closes by handing over the finished object together with its size.
applicability: Reusable as a section close whenever the object has a countable size.
counterevidence: The sentence gives no test of whether 199 links is complete.

source_basis: From the perspective of effective integration of the four elements, this paper selected 12 indicators such as Process Data Information Needs Congruence.
interpretation: The selection is framed by a single stated angle, then illustrated by example.
applicability: Reusable when an indicator set really does share one angle.
counterevidence: Only two of the twelve are named, so the angle is sampled, not shown.

source_basis: Subsequently, this paper used the indicator data obtained from Monte Carlo simulation as the input data of PCA.
interpretation: One method's output is handed to the next by name.
applicability: Reusable for any two-stage computation.
counterevidence: The handoff hides that the Monte Carlo data are synthetic.

source_basis: We selected Mediterranean Shipping Company S.A as an application to demonstrate using MNA-PCA.
interpretation: The demonstration case is named in the summary rather than deferred.
applicability: Reusable when a single real case carries the demonstration.
counterevidence: One firm cannot demonstrate a method for a whole industry.

source_basis: According to the analysis results, the score was 85.14, and it was found that the enterprise should strengthen customs release information.
interpretation: A number and the action it implies share one sentence.
applicability: Reusable when a score directly yields a recommendation.
counterevidence: The summary prints 85.14 while the body prints the ratio 0.8514.

source_basis: This paper proposed to simulate the system by developing a stochastic Petri net that is isomorphic to the meta-network.
interpretation: The new model is introduced by its relation to the old one.
applicability: Reusable when a second model really copies the first.
counterevidence: The isomorphism is asserted here and only argued later.

source_basis: The average detention time was reduced from 140.17 minutes to 85.98 minutes, with a 38.7% reduction.
interpretation: An improvement is reported as a before, an after, and the cut.
applicability: Reusable for any measured improvement.
counterevidence: The summary rounds 140.167 to 140.17.

source_basis: Based on the model's effectiveness, we provided ICM companies with recommendations for applying the model.
interpretation: Advice is offered only after effectiveness is claimed.
applicability: Reusable as the bridge from result to recommendation.
counterevidence: Effectiveness is named but not defined in this sentence.

source_basis: This paper detailed the critical steps needed to apply the model to other industries.
interpretation: The summary closes on transferability rather than on a result.
applicability: Reusable when a paper really does give transfer steps.
counterevidence: The steps appear only in section 7, so the promise is unchecked here.

source_basis: As an important asset owned by the enterprise, data governance refers to its correctness and timeliness, control of data flow, permissions and security.
interpretation: The definition is given by listing the parts it covers.
applicability: Reusable for any definition that is a list.
counterevidence: The list is not tied to a standard.

source_basis: The correct application of the D&A system should be based on accurate and reasonable data.
interpretation: A precondition is stated with should rather than as a finding.
applicability: Reusable for stating what a method needs before it can be used.
counterevidence: The modal should marks this as a wish, not a result.

source_basis: Port logistics service is a complex system engineering.
interpretation: The domain is labelled a complex system in one clause, which licenses a network model.
applicability: Reusable only where the domain genuinely has many actors.
counterevidence: No evidence is offered for the label.

source_basis: The specific requirements of this question are as follows.
interpretation: A single sentence hands the task to a bullet list.
applicability: Reusable before any enumerated brief.
counterevidence: The sentence says nothing on its own.

source_basis: Since this question did not give any port operation data, a quantitative model was developed as a basis for subsequent maturity assessment and process optimization.
interpretation: The missing data is turned into the reason the model exists.
applicability: Reusable whenever a contest problem withholds the data.
counterevidence: The concession also limits every later numerical claim.

source_basis: Due to the lack of data on the operation of the business, this paper used Monte Carlo simulations to capture the changes.
interpretation: Synthetic data is excused in the same sentence that introduces it.
applicability: Reusable for declaring simulated data as simulated.
counterevidence: The excuse does not say how many runs or what was deleted.

source_basis: For ICM Corporation to maximize the benefit of its data information and reduce the transit time, this paper developed a stochastic Petri net.
interpretation: The model's purpose is stated before the model.
applicability: Reusable at the head of a method section.
counterevidence: Two aims are stated but the section serves only the second.

source_basis: A letter related to the maturity of the system is also provided to ICM's customers to increase their confidence in the data practices.
interpretation: The memo is previewed and its purpose is named.
applicability: Reusable when a paper really does include a letter.
counterevidence: Confidence is promised, not measured.

source_basis: ICM Corporation's port-related business is not likely to change significantly shortly.
interpretation: The business is frozen over an unnamed short term.
applicability: Reusable as a stationarity assumption, provided the horizon is stated.
counterevidence: Shortly is never quantified.

source_basis: The maturity of the D&A system is only influenced by the people, technology, process and data information in the introduction.
interpretation: The cause list is closed by the word only.
applicability: Reusable for bounding what a model is allowed to depend on.
counterevidence: Nothing shows that other factors are absent.

source_basis: The illustrative enterprise is consistent with the nature of ICM Corporation and is a good representation of its operations.
interpretation: One firm is licensed to stand for the client.
applicability: Reusable only alongside a statement of how the likeness was judged.
counterevidence: No comparison is offered.

source_basis: There is no conflict between the needs of the different departments in the management team.
interpretation: Disagreement is removed from the model in one clause.
applicability: Reusable as a flagged simplification, not as a finding.
counterevidence: The letter and the indicators both discuss departmental concerns, which this denies.

source_basis: The key mathematical notations used in this paper are listed in Table 1.
interpretation: Every symbol is handed to one table.
applicability: Reusable above any symbol table.
counterevidence: Equation (6) then uses KT, which the table does not settle.

source_basis: The primary purpose of this section is to establish a meta-network and provide a basis for subsequent assessment and optimization.
interpretation: The section announces its one job and its handoff.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a model section.
counterevidence: The sentence promises two later uses the section itself does not perform.

source_basis: Carley et al. (2007) proposed the concept of meta-network, which is a multi-level social network.
interpretation: A borrowed concept arrives with its citation and its definition together.
applicability: Reusable for introducing any borrowed tool.
counterevidence: The citation is repeated twice in the same sentence.

source_basis: Pestov (2009) argued that any natural system, such as society or organization, can be represented by a meta-network.
interpretation: A generality is imported as a warrant and kept attributed.
applicability: Reusable when a cited opinion licenses a modelling choice.
counterevidence: A cited opinion is not the paper's own evidence.

source_basis: Based on the characteristics of the system and the objectives, we can learn that the meta-network model is well suited to this problem.
interpretation: Fitness is declared as a conclusion drawn from stated traits.
applicability: Reusable only after the traits have actually been listed.
counterevidence: The traits given are scale, association and uncertainty, which fit many models.

source_basis: The main steps in developing a meta-network model are identifying nodes and links.
interpretation: The method is reduced to two steps before the subsection that does them.
applicability: Reusable as a preview of the next subsection.
counterevidence: Two steps understate the work of defining nine sub-networks.

source_basis: There is a non-negligible correlation between many factors such as people, technology, process, and data information.
interpretation: The factors are asserted to be tied together, which justifies decomposing them.
applicability: Reusable when the correlation is later measured.
counterevidence: No correlation is computed anywhere in the paper.

source_basis: This paper identifies a total of 33 critical elements based on the core of the port logistics transportation process.
interpretation: The inventory is delivered as a count with its basis.
applicability: Reusable for any counted inventory.
counterevidence: The basis is a citation, not a selection rule.

source_basis: For example, AP Net refers to the involvement of certain people needed to complete a specific process.

applicability: Reusable for walking a reader through a matrix.
counterevidence: Only one of the nine cells is glossed.

source_basis: By analyzing the meta-network, we can obtain practically meaningful multidimensional network indicators, which will be specified in section 4.2.

source_basis: All computed elements in the following are the meta-network 0-1 relationship matrix and are calculated as matrix operations.

source_basis: This indicator represents the amount of data information that is missing for the agent to complete its assigned process.

source_basis: Let NDI = AP*IP' = data information needed by agents to do their assigned process.
interpretation: A helper symbol is named, computed and glossed in one line.
applicability: Reusable for any intermediate quantity.

source_basis: The formula is familiar with that of ADINC.
interpretation: A repeated formula is replaced by a pointer to the earlier one.
applicability: Reusable only when the two formulas genuinely share a shape.

source_basis: This is Process Data Information Needs Congruence with the data information-based networks replaced with the corresponding technology-based networks.
interpretation: A twin indicator is derived by naming the single substitution.

counterevidence: The sentence specifies the swap but not the resulting formula.

source_basis: where, I(A>0) denotes a function that if true returns a value of 1.
interpretation: A notation is glossed inline, in a where-clause.
applicability: Reusable for any indicator function.

source_basis: The indicators selected above address the concerns of ICM Corporation's management team, as shown in Table 5.
interpretation: The indicator list is tied back to the client's worries.
applicability: Reusable for reconnecting a computation to the brief.

source_basis: PCA converts a set of correlated variables into a set of orthogonal, uncorrelated variables using an orthogonal transformation called a principal component.
interpretation: The transform is stated as an input, an output and a tool.

source_basis: The modeling steps for PCA are shown in following steps.
interpretation: A numbered derivation is announced in one line.
applicability: Reusable before any numbered derivation.
counterevidence: The grammar slips, but the function is clear.

source_basis: where f denotes the principal component score and the weight of the principal component is denoted by beta.
interpretation: Both symbols of an equation are read aloud.
applicability: Reusable directly under a displayed equation.
counterevidence: The prose then assigns beta to the ith component while the sum runs over e.

source_basis: We performed 50 Monte Carlo simulations to randomly remove elements from a standard meta-network model.
interpretation: The sampling design is stated as a count and an action.
applicability: Reusable for any simulation experiment.
counterevidence: The distribution of the deletions is not stated.

source_basis: Due to space limitations, only some of the Monte Carlo simulation data is shown in Table 6.
interpretation: A truncated table is marked as partial.
applicability: Reusable above any abridged table.
counterevidence: The excuse could conceal an inconvenient row, and nothing rules that out.

source_basis: According to the calculated results, the cumulative variance contribution of the first six principal components reached 85%, and their characteristic roots were 3.84, 2.30, 1.65, 1.32, and 1.14.
interpretation: A threshold and the roots that meet it are reported together.
applicability: Reusable for justifying how many components to keep.
counterevidence: Five roots are listed for six components.

source_basis: Therefore, the first 5 principal components were selected as indicators in this paper.
interpretation: The kept set is stated as a count.
applicability: Reusable as the close of a selection argument.
counterevidence: The count is five while the previous sentence argued for six.

source_basis: Mediterranean Shipping Company S.A is a global company engaged in shipping and logistics, established in 1970, with more than 200 routes.
interpretation: The case is introduced with three dated, countable facts.
applicability: Reusable for introducing a real case.
counterevidence: No source is given for the facts.

source_basis: Our search of the relevant literature and the analysis of the company's financial reports revealed specific problems in information technology and staff capacity.
interpretation: The diagnosis is credited to named kinds of reading.
applicability: Reusable when the reading was actually done.
counterevidence: No report is cited.

source_basis: We fed back the deficiencies of the illustrative enterprise to the meta-network model of the standard system.
interpretation: Found defects are pushed back into the model, connecting diagnosis to computation.
applicability: Reusable between a qualitative diagnosis and a numerical one.
counterevidence: The verb fed back is vague about exactly which nodes were removed.

source_basis: The ratio of the maturity score of the illustrative enterprise to the maturity score of the standard system is used as the final score, which is calculated as 0.8514.
interpretation: The headline number is defined as a ratio before it is given.
applicability: Reusable for any score reported relative to a baseline.
counterevidence: The summary had already printed the same number as 85.14.

source_basis: Based on the calculation results, we can see that the enterprise's DIBTC, DIO, PTNC and TO indicators are significantly smaller than the standard system.
interpretation: The weak indicators are named rather than summarized.
applicability: Reusable for localizing a weakness.
counterevidence: Significantly is not backed by a test.

source_basis: We were able to calculate through the meta-network model matrix the links that need to be enhanced by data information.
interpretation: The matrix is converted into a repair list.
applicability: Reusable for turning a score into an action list.
counterevidence: The sentence does not say which links.

source_basis: This section describes how to develop a stochastic Petri net using the enterprise's meta-network and simulate the average detention time.
interpretation: The section previews its two jobs in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable at the head of a two-part section.
counterevidence: Both jobs must actually be done.

source_basis: It provides a powerful tool for describing and studying information processing systems that are parallel, asynchronous and stochastic.
interpretation: The tool is praised for three named properties of the system.
applicability: Reusable when the system really has those properties.
counterevidence: Powerful is unsupported on its own.

source_basis: With the stochastic Petri net model, the system's performance can be quantified through a series of transformations to obtain the busy probability, the idle probability and the variable utilization.
interpretation: The deliverable numbers are listed before the derivation.
applicability: Reusable for saying what a model will produce.
counterevidence: Variable utilization is listed but never computed.

source_basis: In this case, the busy probability of the place reflects the utilization of resources and the active status of the tasks in the actual system.
interpretation: A probability is translated into plain words.
applicability: Reusable under any performance metric.
counterevidence: The reading adds active status, which the probability alone does not show.

source_basis: We define a SPN as a seven-tuple.
interpretation: A formal object is announced before its parts.
applicability: Reusable before any formal definition.
counterevidence: The sentence is only an announcement.

source_basis: Before modelling, it is necessary to analyze the specific processes and then map their critical elements to the process elements in the SPN.
interpretation: A prerequisite is inserted before the build.
applicability: Reusable for ordering preparation ahead of construction.
counterevidence: The mapping is asserted rather than tabulated.

source_basis: The logical relationships between place and transition in the SPN use the same logical links as the meta-network links.
interpretation: The structure is inherited from the earlier model, stated outright.
applicability: Reusable when one model really reuses another's structure.
counterevidence: The optimized net later drops and merges transitions, so the inheritance is partial.

source_basis: Corresponding the elements of the meta-network to the essential elements of the SPN is the basis for subsequent work.
interpretation: A step is marked as foundational.
applicability: Reusable for flagging a prerequisite.
counterevidence: The sentence repeats the previous one in different words.

source_basis: The workload of Petri net modelling is significantly reduced by developing an SPN that is isomorphic to the meta-network, improving the efficiency of the study.
interpretation: An efficiency gain is claimed from the isomorphism.
applicability: Reusable only if the saving is real.
counterevidence: The saving is never measured.

source_basis: The colors in the diagram remain the same as the colors of the node types in the meta-network.
interpretation: A visual code is carried across figures so the reader stays oriented.
applicability: Reusable whenever a colour code is reused.
counterevidence: The code is stated but not legend-checked.

source_basis: First, this paper needs to validate the validity of the already established SPN model.
interpretation: A soundness check is announced before the computation.
applicability: Reusable before relying on a constructed model.
counterevidence: The doubled validate the validity is awkward, but the intent is a check.

source_basis: Solve for AX=0 to obtain a set of invariant bits.
interpretation: The linear algebra step is said in words, including what it yields.
applicability: Reusable beside any solved matrix equation.
counterevidence: Invariant bits is the paper's term for place invariants.

source_basis: The following conclusions can be drawn from the correlation matrix and the invariant.
interpretation: A numbered reading of a result is announced.
applicability: Reusable before an interpretation.
counterevidence: The announcement guarantees nothing about whether the conclusions follow.

source_basis: All depots in the constructed model have input conditions, indicating a very smooth articulation process of the port operation process.
interpretation: A structural fact is read as a quality of the operation.
applicability: Reusable when the quality really follows from the fact.
counterevidence: Having inputs does not by itself make a process smooth.

source_basis: There are no processes in the constructed model that can never be performed.
interpretation: A failure mode is denied outright.
applicability: Reusable for reporting the absence of deadlock.
counterevidence: The denial rests on the invariants, which themselves rest on a suspect matrix.

interpretation: The absence of isolates is generalized to executability.
applicability: Reusable as a structural argument, with the suggestion kept as a suggestion.

interpretation: A table is credited to named software.

counterevidence: The sentence gives no values.

interpretation: The headline number is restated in words and given its unit.

applicability: Reusable when a figure shows the change.

interpretation: A substitution is reported with both sides named.

counterevidence: New ideas are not named.

source_basis: Only one representative enterprise has been selected to demonstrate the model proposed in this paper.
interpretation: The narrow evidence is conceded outright.
applicability: Reusable for bounding a single-case demonstration.
counterevidence: The concession does not quantify how much it weakens the claim.

source_basis: Future research could add example systems.
interpretation: The missing work is named in the fewest words.
applicability: Reusable after a concession.
counterevidence: The remedy is vague.

source_basis: The meta-network model is based on the literature and relevant policy documents only and can be subject to expert consultation in the event of sufficient time.
interpretation: The evidence base is bounded and an upgrade is offered with its condition.
applicability: Reusable for conceding a source limitation.
counterevidence: The condition, sufficient time, is not a methodological one.

source_basis: I would like to thank you for your trust in choosing ICM Corporation as your partner.
interpretation: The letter opens on gratitude.
applicability: Reusable for opening a client letter.
counterevidence: The thanks assumes a relationship the contest problem invented.

source_basis: ICM Corporation insists on being customer-oriented and adheres to the concept of people-oriented and win-win cooperation.
interpretation: The firm's stance is stated as a slogan.
applicability: Reusable only for a firm's own stated values.
counterevidence: The slogan is unsupported.

source_basis: Bringing tremendous success to our customers is a constant motivation for us at ICM Corporation.
interpretation: The client's success is tied to the firm's motive.
applicability: Reusable for personalizing an institution in a letter.
counterevidence: Tremendous is unmeasured.

source_basis: ICM Corporation has implemented the new logistics core strategy of Supply Chain plus Big Data plus AIOT and created a system with independent intellectual property rights.
interpretation: The strategy and the product are announced together.
applicability: Reusable for presenting an offering.
counterevidence: AIOT is undefined.

source_basis: ICM Corporation conducted a four-day D&A system maturity assessment and optimization exercise on 2022.2.18.
interpretation: The engagement is dated.
applicability: Reusable for fixing work in time.
counterevidence: The date is an exercise date, not a real engagement.

source_basis: The consulting team develops a standard meta-network model based on the port logistics industry's most advanced D&A system architecture.
interpretation: The work is attributed to the team and to a base.
applicability: Reusable for crediting work in a letter.
counterevidence: Most advanced is undefined.

source_basis: Feeding the current status of ICM's D&A system into a standard meta-network enables the assessment of its maturity.
interpretation: The assessment is reduced to one action for a lay reader.
applicability: Reusable for restating a method without its formulas.
counterevidence: The sentence omits the principal component step.

source_basis: The SPN model enables the simulation of logistic transport detention times based on ICM's D&A system data.
interpretation: The second deliverable is named for the reader.
applicability: Reusable for listing deliverables in plain words.
counterevidence: The model uses assumed delays, not ICM's data.

source_basis: ICM's D&A system maturity assessment level is Excellent.
interpretation: The result is delivered as a single grade.
applicability: Reusable only when the grade is defined by a scale.
counterevidence: No scale is defined anywhere, and the body reports a ratio of 0.8514.

source_basis: The average dwell time of port transport equipment decreased by 38.7%.
interpretation: The improvement is delivered as one percentage.
applicability: Reusable for the single number a letter can carry.
counterevidence: The letter drops the two endpoints the body was careful to give.

source_basis: ICM's consultancy project has shown that the modelling tools provided by the consultancy are a powerful tool for assessing and planning logistics business processes.
interpretation: The project is elevated into a testimonial.
applicability: Reusable for closing a letter on endorsement.
counterevidence: One exercise cannot show this.

source_basis: ICM Corporation will continue to work with this consultancy to continuously improve the data asset application capabilities of the D&A system.
interpretation: An ongoing engagement is promised.
applicability: Reusable for extending a client relationship.
counterevidence: The promise is the contest's fiction.

source_basis: ICM Corporation will strive to develop into a preeminent port logistics service provider, offering our customers complete logistics solutions and logistics services.
interpretation: The letter states an ambition and an offer.
applicability: Reusable for ending on ambition.
counterevidence: Complete logistics solutions exceeds anything the model does.

source_basis: We hope you will keep your faith in ICM's D&A system and ICM Corporation.
interpretation: The letter closes on a plea.
applicability: Reusable as the close of a client letter.
counterevidence: The plea asks for confidence the undefined grade cannot support.

source_basis: Eight works are listed, each with authors, year, title and venue, from Almotairi and Lumsden (2009) to Wold, Esbensen and Geladi (1987).
interpretation: The paper closes on a full reference list rather than a bare mention.
applicability: Reusable as the standard close.
counterevidence: One entry is cited only for the principal component method, which is textbook.

source_basis: The meta-network has 33 nodes of four types and 199 links, split into nine sub-networks.
interpretation: One structure carries both the scoring and the simulation.
applicability: Fits a system whose actors fall into a few named types.
counterevidence: The link criterion is never stated.

source_basis: Twelve indicators are matrix operations on the 0-1 meta-matrix, six of them produced by swapping the data-information networks for the technology networks.
interpretation: A whole indicator family is generated by one substitution rule.
applicability: Fits any paired relation matrices.
counterevidence: Equation (6) breaks the rule by introducing an undefined matrix.

source_basis: The maturity score is a weighted sum of the twelve indicators, with weights taken from the component decomposition.
interpretation: Twelve correlated measures collapse to one number.
applicability: Fits any indicator set that must become a single score.
counterevidence: The printed weights do not sum to one.

source_basis: The net is defined as a seven-tuple and its mean delay is the mean token count divided by the throughput.
interpretation: A standard performance identity is applied to the port.
applicability: Fits any token-flow system with exponential transitions.
counterevidence: The delays are assumed, not measured.

source_basis: The plan is ordered by the missing data: no data, so a document-built network, so simulated indicators, so a copied net.
interpretation: Each model is motivated by the gap the previous one leaves.
applicability: Fits a contest problem that withholds its data.
counterevidence: The order is narrated rather than justified against alternatives.

source_basis: The invariants are read first as smooth articulation and then as the absence of any process that can never run.
interpretation: Structure is taken to imply executability.
applicability: Fits a net whose matrix is trustworthy.
counterevidence: The incidence matrix has a stray entry, so the invariants are not clean.

source_basis: Agreement between the four-node deletion and the example firm is offered as a demonstration of stability and feasibility.
interpretation: A resemblance is promoted to a validation.
applicability: Fits only as a consistency check.
counterevidence: The example firm was itself built by deleting four nodes, so the agreement is partly by construction.

source_basis: Figure 5 plots the component roots from 3.84 down to 0.01.
interpretation: The scree plot is the only display of how many components matter.
applicability: Fits any component analysis.
counterevidence: The prose argues from six components while the plot is then read as five.

source_basis: The tree diagram prints TAW at 8.28 percent.
interpretation: The diagram exposes the misplaced decimal in equation (11).
applicability: Fits any case where a figure restates a formula.
counterevidence: The diagram is captioned as a figure whose number collides with the scree plot.

source_basis: Figure 8 redraws the net with three transitions run in parallel.
interpretation: The figure is the only place the structural changes are visible at once.
applicability: Fits any before-and-after process model.
counterevidence: The figure's node labels must be matched against Table 14 by hand.

source_basis: Figure 9 pairs bars of 140.167 and 85.98 minutes with a pie split 62 to 38.
interpretation: The figure restates the headline cut in two forms.
applicability: Fits a single before-and-after result.
counterevidence: The pie adds no information the bars lack.

source_basis: Solving A X = 0 produces two invariant vectors, used to argue that no process is unreachable.
interpretation: A linear-algebra check stands in for a reachability argument.
applicability: Fits a small net.
counterevidence: A stray 1 in the incidence matrix undermines both invariants.

source_basis: Table 12 reports fourteen steady-state probabilities computed in MATLAB.
interpretation: The balance is solved numerically and tabulated.
applicability: Fits any finite-state net.
counterevidence: The probabilities are not shown to sum to one in the text.

source_basis: Four deletion scenarios of 50 runs each are compared with the example firm.
interpretation: The sensitivity sweep is the paper's only robustness check.
applicability: Fits a network score.
counterevidence: The check reuses the same deletion mechanism that built the example.

source_basis: The 33 elements are identified from technical specifications, government documents and the literature.
interpretation: The whole network rests on documents because no operating data was given.
applicability: Fits a problem that withholds its data.
counterevidence: Documents record intended practice, not actual practice.

source_basis: Fifty Monte Carlo runs delete elements at random to produce the indicator sample.
interpretation: The training data for the component analysis is entirely synthetic.
applicability: Fits a score that must be built without observations.
counterevidence: Random deletion is not a model of how a real system fails.

source_basis: Four assumptions are stated with no justification: stability, a closed cause list, representativeness, and no departmental conflict.
interpretation: The assumptions are listed rather than defended.
applicability: Fits a short contest paper.
counterevidence: The no-conflict assumption is contradicted by the departmental concerns the indicators are built to address.

source_basis: Transition delays are tabulated as given numbers, from 1 to 30 time units.
interpretation: The delays are assumptions presented as data.
applicability: Fits a net whose rates were never measured.
counterevidence: The optimized delays contradict the unoptimized table.

source_basis: The example firm scores 0.8514 against the standard network.
interpretation: A single ratio locates the firm below the reference.
applicability: Fits a one-firm demonstration.
counterevidence: The weights behind the score do not sum to one, so the third digit is not meaningful.

source_basis: The unoptimized net delays transport equipment by 140.167 minutes.
interpretation: The baseline delay is computed from the balance, not assumed.
applicability: Fits the same net.
counterevidence: It inherits the tautological balance equation.

source_basis: The optimized net delays equipment by 85.980 minutes, a reduction of 38.7 percent.
interpretation: The improvement is reported as both a level and a percentage.
applicability: Fits a before-and-after simulation.
counterevidence: The cut depends on assumed delays, one of which is misstated in the prose.

source_basis: Equation (6) divides by the sum of KT, and neither KT nor the transposed T is defined anywhere.
interpretation: One of the twelve indicators cannot be recomputed from the text.
applicability: Applies to every reading of the indicator set.
counterevidence: The technology twin of this indicator is also undefined, so two indicators fail together.

source_basis: Equation (8) sums its denominator only up to i, and equation (9) uses e both as a free index and as the index of summation while leaving p undefined.
interpretation: The variance weights are not well-defined expressions.
applicability: Applies to the component weighting.
counterevidence: Table 7's variance shares do sum plausibly, so the printed numbers may come from a correct formula the text misstates.

source_basis: Equation (11) gives TAW the coefficient 0.8028, names BIDTC and RBTC, and its twelve coefficients sum to about 1.72.
interpretation: The score cannot be rebuilt from the printed equation.
applicability: Applies to the headline maturity number.
counterevidence: The tree diagram prints 8.28 percent, which shows the coefficient is a typo for 0.0828, but the names and the sum remain wrong.

source_basis: The third line of the balance sets lambda_3 x_2 equal to lambda_2 x_2, and the normalization sums from x_1 to x_13, excluding x_0.
interpretation: The steady-state system as printed is singular and mis-normalized.
applicability: Applies to every probability in Table 12.
counterevidence: The tabulated probabilities may still be the solution of the intended system.

source_basis: The prose says the delay of T4 fell from 30 to 20 time units, while Table 11 gives T4 the delay 10 and T3 the delay 30.
interpretation: The stated cause of the improvement names the wrong transition.
applicability: Applies to the 38.7 percent claim.
counterevidence: Table 15 does show shorter delays, so some improvement is real even if the attribution is wrong.

source_basis: Figure 12, cited as the five extension steps, draws disaster-stage meta-networks labelled prevention, resistance and recovery, with Agent, Knowledge, Resource and Task.
interpretation: The transfer argument rests on a figure from another domain.
applicability: Applies to the cross-industry claim.
counterevidence: The five steps are still written out in the prose.

source_basis: The paper concedes that only one enterprise was demonstrated and that the network rests on literature and policy documents alone.
interpretation: The two limits the paper names are the ones that bound its evidence.
applicability: Applies to every claim of generality.
counterevidence: The paper does not concede the formula errors.

source_basis: The letter grades the maturity Excellent, but the body reports only the ratio 0.8514 and defines no band.
interpretation: The grade has no scale behind it.
applicability: Applies to the letter's headline claim.
counterevidence: The 38.7 percent cut stated beside it does trace back to the body.

source_basis: Eight references are real and include Carley et al. (2007), Pestov (2009) and Wold, Esbensen and Geladi (1987).
interpretation: The borrowed methods are traceable to real sources.
applicability: Fits the citation check.
counterevidence: The principal component citation is generic.
